name: XAI-driven transparency mitigation
comments: Significant breakthroughs in eXplainable AI (XAI) for cybersecurity are expected to fix the root causes of this risk.

name: Holistic human-AI advisory approach
comments: AI systems positioned as advisories to human experts rather than autonomous decision-makers.

name: Bias-correction R&D for AI systems
comments: R&D efforts in progress but not yet producing satisfactory results.

name: Adversarial ML defense R&D
comments: No reliable short-term resolution; several R&D efforts promise improvement in the middle-to-long run only.

name: Safety, legislation, and ethics frameworks + holistic approach
comments: Cumulative efforts on safety/security/legislation/ethics frameworks, combined with keeping AI in an advisory role, are on the right track.

name: Privacy-centric AI training frameworks
comments: Promising R&D exists but is in early stages; benefits expected only in the middle-to-long run.

name: AI-cybercrime legislation
comments: Rigorous legislation is being developed but lacks systematic application precedent. Note: 'misuse' in military/cyberwarfare/state-backed contexts is likely to remain an authorized, if controlled, use case.

name: XAI-based threat-coverage assessment
comments: XAI breakthroughs promise better threat-coverage assessment; rehearsal-vs-actual-attack-condition assessment remains untackled.

name: Pre-emptive AI-driven cyber-defense system
comments: High-level architecture/conceptual framework for a preventative AI-driven cyber-defense system with real-time intelligence and dynamic risk analytics.

name: Hybrid Augmented Intelligence (human-AI collaboration)
comments: AI-powered cognitive technologies as an essential but human-guided part of the operational process.

name: Quantitative modeling of AI's patch-deployment impact
comments: Modeling shows more opportunity for automated/accelerated patch deployment than for automated patch development.

name: AI + quantum computing synergy for cyber-defense
comments: Promises exponential advantage for certain cybersecurity problem classes, but is also forecast to pose unexpected new threats. Does not map to a Chapter 1 risk category -- flagged as a possible emerging/unmapped risk pending later chapters.
link_comment: AI+quantum synergy folded under Vulnerability to attacks pending later-chapter clarification.

name: XAI as a standard ML-pipeline component
comments: XAI becomes a must-have part of cybersecurity AI ML pipelines.

name: Global legal and AI-ethics framework consensus
comments: Major global/regional/national stakeholders agree on legal and AI-ethical frameworks for sustainable cybersecurity AI.

name: AI risk management + security-by-design frameworks
comments: AI risk management frameworks (see Appendix B) and product security/safety guidelines embedded from the start of AI system development.

name: Arms control over military/cyberwarfare AI use
comments: Proper establishment of arms control over AI in military and cyberwarfare use cases.

name: Increased industry-academia AI lab synergy
comments: More synergy between leading AI labs in business and academia to address critical cybersecurity AI risks over the next 2-3 years.
